title: actinophloeus kerstenianus
intro: Actinophloeus kerstenianus, commonly known as the African quassia, is a plant species found in tropical Africa, characterized by its distinctive leaves and medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its various health benefits, including the treatment of parasitic infections, fever, and rheumatism. The therapeutic actions of Actinophloeus kerstenianus include anti-inflammatory, antiparasitic, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
